# New Nuevo

> New Nuevo is a London digital product studio that combines strategy, branding, UX and UI design, web development, and mobile product delivery.

Canonical website: https://newnuevo.com/

## Services

- Strategy and ideation: discovery, consultation and prototyping that turns early concepts into a clear product direction.
- Design and branding: brand identities and visual systems for print and digital touchpoints.
- UX and UI design: research, user experience, interface design, prototypes and design systems.
- Software development: accessible websites, web applications, iOS, Android and cross-platform mobile products.

## Selected work

- No. 30 Knightsbridge: branding, print and digital work for a London hotel and events venue.
- Courier Media: digital, web and print work for an independent media brand.
- Studio 5: digital and web work for a creative content studio.

## Location

New Nuevo is based at Creative Works, First Floor, 7 Blackhorse Lane, London, E17 6DS, United Kingdom.
